steps.subject: How your money data is protected in fortuna
steps.previewText: Keys you can revoke, a change log you can undo, an export you own.

alternative.subject: Before you give an agent your card statement
alternative.previewText: Where your data lives, who can touch it, and how you stop them.

steps.markdown:
Hi,

The first question people ask: what if the agent gets something wrong, or gets more than I meant to give it? Here is what is true today.

- Your agent gets a key, not your password. Read only or read and write, named by you, last use shown. Revoke stops it on the next request.
- fortuna keeps only the key's fingerprint. You see it once.
- Every agent change is on the Changes page with its name and time. Undo reverses it.
- Export JSON from Settings any time. Delete my data removes the tracker's data.
- Encryption at rest for the database and PDF archive. [pending QI-27046]
- Export with your PDFs; account deletion that also clears the archive and backups. [pending QI-27046]

One honest limit: what your agent reads goes to your AI provider. Pick one you trust, or start read-only.

[Reply with the line you'd want proof of] mailto:[sender address]

David

steps.previewText: One real flow, shown on sample data, from the PDF to the Changes page.

alternative.subject: The part of budgeting you skip, done by your agent
alternative.previewText: Card statement in, transactions filed, one Undo button. Sample data.

steps.markdown:
Hi,

Here is the flow, on sample data (invented, no real account).

You, to your agent: “Here's the September card statement. File it in fortuna.”

Your agent: “Done. 23 transactions added from card-statement-2026-09.pdf, 4 moved to Groceries. Two looked like duplicates of August, so I left them out. Everything is on the Changes page and can be undone.”

In fortuna, the Changes page now shows two rows signed by the key you named, say "receipts", each with an Undo button. The PDF sits in Documents, linked to its rows. Click Undo on the first row and the 23 transactions are gone. That undo can be undone too.

The agent does the filing you skip. The dashboard keeps the receipt of what it did.

It works with any agent that speaks MCP. A key from Settings → Agent access is all it needs.
